highlights: Criminal record transparency and background checks
safety.policy_summary: ICSN maintains a strict Child Safeguarding Policy aligned with the Thai Child Protection Act (B.E. 2546) and the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child. The policy relies on three main pillars: Universal Duty of Care, Continuous Staff Vetting & Training (including O.S.C.A.R. registration and background checks), and Child Protection Response via a designated Child Protection Team and mandatory reporting tools.
